verdict.rationale: Adyen Issuing's own transaction rules are a configured automation that runs unattended, approving or declining every authorization without user involvement. Relayed authorisation also applies configurable fallback logic (default approval or refusal) when a reply misses the 2000 ms window. Both are narrow, authorization-scoped automations, not general background workflows, and webhooks alone are only building blocks. Missing for 10: general-purpose automation or workflow setup beyond authorization decisioning, scheduled or recurring background jobs, agent-driven autonomous actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Create transaction rules to automatically approve or decline authorizations.
You can use transaction rules to configure a logic that automatically declines an authorization that does not meet your business' requirements.
If you do not respond within 2000 milliseconds, you can specify which fallback logic you want: Default approval, Default refusal
